category_title: Students engaging in rhythmic call-and-response for content reinforcement
minimal_context: The teacher is attempting to gain the attention of the entire class before transitioning to the next science activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Before we move to the science activity that is next on the agenda, if you can hear my voice clap once.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not respond to the first prompt)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you can hear my voice clap twice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not respond to the second prompt)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, I need everyone's attention so we can begin the lab.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to not respond to the standard classroom management prompts, as it often takes up to three call prompts to receive a response from the entire class)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Before we move to the science activity that is next on the agenda, if you can hear my voice clap once.

STUDENT: (Does not respond to the first prompt)

TUTOR: If you can hear my voice clap twice.

STUDENT: (Does not respond to the second prompt)

TUTOR: Class, I need everyone's attention so we can begin the lab.

STUDENT: (Continues to not respond to the standard classroom management prompts, as it often takes up to three call prompts to receive a response from the entire class)
